gaps.sentence: Air ___ (POLLUTE) is a serious problem in big cities.
gaps.explanation: The subject must be a noun: pollution (-tion noun); a pollutant is a specific polluting substance.

gaps.sentence: Their ___ goes back to their schooldays (FRIEND).
gaps.hint: noun needed: the state of being friends (-ship)
gaps.explanation: The suffix -ship forms nouns of state: friendship means the relationship between friends.

gaps.sentence: The instructions were unclear, so I had to ___ them completely (WRITE).
gaps.hint: write again — unclear the first time (re-); base verb needed
gaps.explanation: The prefix re- means again: rewrite. A base verb is needed after 'had to'.

gaps.sentence: The government wants to ___ the tax system (SIMPLE).
gaps.explanation: The suffix -ify forms the verb: simplify means to make simple. A base verb follows 'to'.

gaps.sentence: His sudden ___ came as a shock to everyone (DEPART).
gaps.hint: noun needed as subject (-ure); beware the word meaning 'part of an organisation'
gaps.explanation: The noun of 'depart' is departure (-ure); a department is a section of an organisation.
A bank manager is a person; 'management' is the activity and 'manage' is the verb.

gaps.sentence: I'm afraid your passport is ___ — it expired last month (VALID).
gaps.hint: negative adjective needed: it has expired
gaps.explanation: An expired document is invalid (in- + valid); an adjective is needed after 'is'.

gaps.sentence: It is ___ to book tickets in advance during the festival (ADVICE).
gaps.explanation: The suffix -able forms the adjective: advisable means worth recommending. 'It is + adjective + to-infinitive'.
